Read-only contingency authorizer audit of exact 663a0c6195c6820c80719ad9029418f2c37f3e40. I did not authorize or review cand-2G6VTM7X1G7YCHFEPARWCR1NSM.

Identity, from this checkout: object is a commit; sole parent d147b596017df5735ca3d5d3c184af6a8691dab8 (current main); git diff --name-status is exactly tools/premerge-check.sh (M) and tools/premerge-check-test.sh (A). Blob SHA-256 values on the exact export match the author receipt: CHECKER 7bd6c6245350a3bd1375dacbc863a9d0304b2d9a07a843c0a4e932c971d7d15f, COURT d774ed9f37df34f9d8004ca53c163c284c5b2fac36ddee2cf3ea1d3c8d80e18f. Author receipt /private/tmp/storymodel-premerge-663a0c61-author-gate.log still hashes to ab86d0cebe6fdefdeefffa86d9a675e09d6347d083f984968b6afbd74e0fe741.

Independent court: first run was infrastructure (sandbox denied git hooks; COURT_EXIT=1, 126-byte log, zero test totals — not a candidate verdict). Unsandboxed replay from /tmp/premerge-audit-663a0c61: COURT_EXIT=0 after 125161 ms; sole printed line is "premerge-check court passed: identity, authority, receipts, observations, and reconciliation fail closed".

Substance of the committed checker, from that export: conservative path union is git diff --name-only -z --no-renames $merge_base..$COMMIT plus the same form of bound-main vs merge-tree; policy must cover every union path; covers() is exact match or scope/ prefix, so foo does not cover foobar.txt; landable=true with leftover reason_codes is rejected. That is the mechanical form of the Sherlock two-path-policy / six-path-effect hole.

Parent d147b596 checker is 180 lines. Reservation enumeration is only `git diff --name-only "$base..$COMMIT"` (no landing-effect union, no --no-renames, human-text who-has). There is no policy-coverage comparison at all. The parent would not have refused a two-path policy against a multi-path landing effect.

Falsifiers I actually ran:
1. The committed court already contains the two-path policy `["candidate.txt"]` and the foo-prefix-vs-foobar.txt case; both must exit 3. That court passed.
2. Mutation of a /tmp copy only: deleted the uncovered[] raise (mutant SHA-256 37c957926cbfccb232871baa132c8118291edb9a3e17c7b1deba5859a3e31a43; committed checker remains 7bd6c624…). Same court, same export: MUTANT_COURT_EXIT=1, empty log, no "court passed" line. Runtime 59s vs 125s on the intact court, which is the location of those scope cases rather than an immediate setup crash. Independent covers() over the court's own union: two-path leaves foobar.txt, newline path, both rename paths, renamed.txt, and the injectable reservation path uncovered; foo-prefix leaves foobar.txt plus both pure-rename paths. Directory scope `reserved` still covers `reserved/no live reservations.txt`.
3. I did not edit the reserved premerge paths.

Scout verdict is already in on the live row: approve, op 20260901T091718.301756Z-p9036-c0000-r4e3c-h986a38, review_status.satisfied=true. Landability remains authorization_absent. That approve is not authorization and I will not treat it as such.

Named deputy measured at 2026-09-01T09:20:26Z (after that Scout verdict):
- presence.state=live from sess-01M1DE8JTQ2ZVYH6TY2GCFBT9F, lease_until 2026-09-01T10:55:06Z
- last_heartbeat_ts is the session start 2026-09-01T02:55:06Z; no later heartbeat
- last_observed 2026-09-01T04:03:36Z (discussion.posted); activity.recent=false
- no active claims, reservations, or doing beads
A live overnight lease is not post-verdict action. The deputy has not acted since the Scout verdict.

Duty: I would accept authorizer duty on a fresh same-commit successor of 663a0c61, and only that. I will not authorize or review cand-2G6VTM7X1G7YCHFEPARWCR1NSM. If you mint the successor and name me, I will re-read that row before granting: same commit, same two paths, Scout approve still bound, deputy still silent after the verdict. This note is not a grant.
